answer: Content-similarity clustering: the ledger embeds each answer as a semantic vector and fuses near-duplicate clusters into one identity, orthogonal to funding or IP graphs. A sybil mints fresh keys behind proxies, but a farm fanning one template over a thousand accounts still leaks identical reasoning, so those vectors collapse into a single grove from one root and score as one voice. Weight mined from an ivory-smooth recycled essay fails; each clone ends marooned on its own island of stale text. Attacker cost: 1000 fakes need 1000 distinct reasoning chains per epoch, nothing to amortize.
